name: Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite
description: Google DeepMind's most cost-efficient model in the Gemini 3.5 family, designed for high-volume, low-latency applications where economy is paramount. Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite delivers strong performance for everyday tasks at the lowest price point of the new July 2026 Gemini release batch, while retaining multimodal input capabilities and the 1M token context window.
keyFeatures: Most cost-efficient model in the new Gemini batch — lowest price per token
Multimodal input support: text, image, audio, and video
1M token context window for long-form processing
Part of Google's July 2026 Gemini release alongside 3.6 Flash and 3.5 Flash Cyber
curatorNotes: Released July 21, 2026 as the lightweight complement to Gemini 3.6 Flash. Exact pricing and benchmark scores TBD from Google's official pricing page.
